integrity: The proof is symbolic and unbounded. Finite computation is used only as regression evidence. The focal source's online-publication date is used rather than its manuscript-received date; the 2025 follow-up supplies an explicit 2020 MSC 11A25 classification for the same function family.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies parameter fibers for a fixed base integer. It does not classify equality between different base integers, and the originality search cannot exclude equivalent formulations in uninspected literature.
title: Exact parameter fibers of \(g_\alpha\)
